project.title: Picksy Picks
project.subtitle: A Pinterest-inspired shopping discovery system that recommends products, similar users, similar items, clusters, and sponsored picks.

dataset.interactionType: Implicit feedback from ratings and product interactions

pipeline: Train popularity, collaborative filtering, neural MF, graph embeddings, and LightFM models
Evaluate with HitRate@K, NDCG@K, and MRR@K
Serve top-K recommendations in an interactive web demo
project.backendMode: Snapshot API mode: localhost backend serves notebook-exported recommendation data. Replace backend/data/demo-data.json with a fresh export after rerunning the notebook.

models.name: Popularity
models.description: Ranks globally strong items. Simple, fast, and surprisingly competitive for sparse marketplace data.

models.name: Neural Matrix Factorization
models.description: Learns user and item embeddings with a neural scoring layer for personalized ranking.

models.name: LightFM WARP
models.description: Optimizes ranking with WARP loss and can be extended with metadata features.

models.name: Graph Embeddings
models.description: Builds a user-item graph and uses random-walk embeddings to score user-item links.

models.name: Matrix Factorization SVD
models.description: Projects the user-item matrix into a lower-dimensional latent space.

models.name: User-Based CF
models.description: Finds users with similar histories and recommends what similar users liked.

models.name: Item-Based CF
models.description: Recommends products similar to items already seen by the user.
